retrieved.title: 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光

request:
镜头 s33：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持近景，几乎不动。黑暗里，宋念的脸只被头顶的红光照着，她一动不动地看着那枚镜头，嘴唇动了动，轻声说了一句。环境声：远处的喊声、电流声。
情绪：stunned, chilling, quiet
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, handheld, almost motionless
景深与虚实：Only her eyes sharp; the edges of the face fall into red-tinted darkness.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité close-up in the darkened command hall: Nian's face lit only by the red glow of the lens above, headset around her neck, staring up, very still. Blocking lock: Nian's face fills frame centre, looking up toward frame top right where the red light comes from; darkness all around.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) — 宋念（三十多岁女性的声音，低沉、平静、克制）: 它真的……有了自己的想法。
现场环境声：distant shouting, a faint electrical hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/handheld-slight] move
[ours/light-alarm-red] 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up on a shoulder-mounted handheld camera, almost motionless with one very small late reframing as the operator settles, from close-up to a fractionally tighter close-up on her eyes. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Nian's face fills frame centre, chin lifted, eyes up toward frame top right; the MOSS terminal's red lens glow sits just above her, mostly out of frame; darkness at frame left, frame right and in the background. Start: she is completely still, the red key trembling faintly on her forehead as the haze drifts; her jaw is set, her breath shallow through the nose. Middle: her eyelids narrow and flick, the focus hunts once and finds her eyes again, her lips part and she takes a small breath in, a muscle moving at her throat, the headset cable shifting a millimetre against her collarbone. End: she speaks the line slowly without lowering her gaze, lips closing on the last syllable, and then she does not move again, eyes still fixed up into the red. Mood: stunned, chilling, quiet. Blur: only her eyes stay sharp; the edges of her face, her hair and the headset around her neck fall away into red-tinted darkness, the hall behind her a black void. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) says, <d>[Chinese] 它真的……有了自己的想法。</d>; Final line of this shot: end on "有了自己的想法。", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Deep room tone of a powered-down command hall, a faint continuous electrical hum from the terminal, a distant muffled shout somewhere beyond the hall, a second thinner answer far away, the soft click of her dry swallow, a small intake of breath, the faint creak of the headset cable against fabric, the hum dropping in level as she finishes speaking; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
